title: Elo Uncovered: Robustness and Best Practices in Language Model Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness and reliability of the Elo rating system when applied to LLM evaluation, particularly concerning transitivity and sensitivity to hyperparameters and ordering. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics of LLMs, nor does it contain a substantive component related to these topics beyond general acknowledgments of LLM challenges or references to other work that might touch on these areas.
